purpose: Reconcile the VM's Cargo lock with its selected compiler and language sources so the owner build can run offline and locked.

finding.previous_locked_build_blocker: The selected language source requires Cranelift 0.136.2 while the VM lock selected 0.121.2; cargo metadata --offline --locked rejected the stale lock.
finding.registry_package_alignment: The VM and selected language Cargo.lock files contain the same registry package name/version/source set.
finding.offline_metadata_observation: After lock reconciliation, cargo metadata --offline --locked attempted to fetch windows-link 0.2.1, which was absent from the local cache. This does not establish a Linux build failure; the exact Linux VM provider build below succeeded.

toolchain.assurance: local build observation; not independent attestation

interpretation: This verifies the selected Linux provider build and its embedded-input receipt. It does not establish that offline cargo metadata succeeds on hosts missing Windows-target crates, nor does it establish compiler execution or Stage-1 evidence.
